headline: Live updates, reaction as Pochettino agrees USMNT exit for Man United

description: After years of near-misses, Man United have finally landed Mauricio Pochettino, a manager with the kind of pedigree, class and credibility the club have been looking for.

headline: Alexis Mac Allister's father: No contract renewal talks with Liverpool yet
